lessons: The check failed because the ticket's Scope in requires phase3-exit to be 'KNOWN-HARD high/high'. Section 20's registry makes every Phase 3 seed medium/medium unless marked KNOWN-DEEP. phase3-exit has no such mark, and 'KNOWN-HARD' is not a registry term.

Satisfying the ticket gets the tier flagged by requisition review. Using medium/medium breaks the ticket's own Scope in. The fix belongs in the plan or ticket first: mark phase3-exit KNOWN-DEEP in section 20, or change the ticket to medium/medium.

The rest of the work passed both pytest commands and the ticket linter: soak-run, the phase3-continue-23 fences, Context partitions, render headroom and terminal suffix. Keep tests/test_seeded_phase3_22.py once the tier conflict is settled.

When re-authoring, pin phase3-exit's tier to whatever section 20 grants in the tests/test_seeded_phase3_23.py requirements and the continuation's acceptance criteria. Never use an unregistered label such as KNOWN-HARD.
reason: The ticket requires a high/high KNOWN-HARD tier for phase3-exit that its cited section 20 registry does not grant, so the ticket or plan must be fixed before any attempt can pass requisition review.
